name: manual_ae7945
claim: For persisted anti-rollback clocks, sample an aware current time after acquiring the write lock; a request-time sample can appear older than another valid writer without actual rollback. Recheck registry freshness, key trust and expiry at the nonce-consumption boundary while keeping real rollback refusals.

decisions.notes: The reviewed operator assertion repair and Phylax #31 recheck current validity under the consuming write lock; source-level regressions distinguish valid interleaving from real rollback and refuse without consuming a nonce. https://github.com/oramasys/phylax/pull/31 ; https://github.com/oramasys/phylax/pull/30#pullrequestreview-5743182823
